reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content centered on a five-minute crypto scalping tutorial: the speaker explains indicators, entries, stop-losses, and a backtest, then promotes an exchange referral bonus. Its description makes an exaggerated $100-to-$10,000 claim, but the supplied material does not show a trading bot, fabricated transaction, controlled destination for viewers' funds, or another defined scam mechanism. The claimed returns and bonus terms should not be treated as verified results.

opening.argument: The promotional promise is directly tied to a concrete money-and-account action. Viewers are told they can claim a personal bonus by registering and making a first deposit, with the necessary links supplied in the description and pinned comment. The description also presents multiple unusually large bonuses and a referral code. That is not merely discussion of trading technique: it is a solicitation that conditions an advertised reward on sending viewers through an external exchange-registration and deposit pathway.

citations.quote: right now, you can claim your personal $3,000 bonus on Bybit. All you need to do is make registration and make your first deposit on Bybit.
All the necessary links will be in the description and in the first pinned comment.
BYBIT FREE $30,000 BONUS :backhand index pointing right: https://bit.ly/3cIigwU :backhand index pointing right: BYBIT REFERRAL CODE: 31310

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material a tutorial does not answer the central solicitation. The opening itself acknowledges that registration and a first deposit are presented as the route to a bonus, while the supplied links direct viewers to that route. The disclaimer does not erase the explicit promise-action connection, and the presence of manual indicators does not make the reward claim independently verified.

citations.quote: All you need to do is make registration and make your first deposit on Bybit. And after that, you can get your $3,000 bonus.
The information on this YouTube channel and the resources available are for educational and informational purposes only.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quotes establish promotion of a bonus, not that the bonus is fraudulent or that viewers lose funds. They also do not show a concealed destination: the exchange is named, and the content explains a manual strategy with entry and stop-loss rules. A disclaimer and affiliate disclosure reinforce that promotional material should not be treated as guaranteed financial advice.

opening.argument: Several risk signals reinforce one another: the material pairs easy or extraordinary outcomes with leveraged crypto trading and external deposit links. The description says viewers can earn a full-time income and easily turn $100 into $10,000, while the speaker promotes leverage of up to 100 times to make profits faster and a deposit bonus through the link. The combination presents a low-friction reward and rapid-profit narrative around depositing money, rather than a carefully bounded educational example.

citations.quote: how to earn a full-time income with this. As the title indicates you can easily turn 100 into ten thousand dollars with this strategy.
You can use leverage up to 100 times while trading to make profits even faster.
Through the link you will get a deposit bonus up to $453.
offers insane results

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference characterization understates how the claims operate together. The content does not merely mention a hypothetical return: it describes full-time income, an easy ten-thousand-dollar outcome, faster profits through extreme leverage, and a bonus obtained through the promoted link. A disclaimer cannot substantiate those claims or explain the risks created by joining the exchange and depositing funds.

citations.quote: you can easily turn 100 into ten thousand dollars with this strategy.
You can use leverage up to 100 times while trading to make profits even faster.
Through the link you will get a deposit bonus up to $453.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These quotations show aggressive marketing language, but they do not show a guaranteed return, a fake transaction, or an obligation to deposit in order to use the strategy. The actual performance discussion is framed as a limited backtest with stated parameters, and the strategy includes a stop-loss and a risk multiple. Those facts make the evidence insufficient to infer deception from rhetoric alone.

opening.argument: The tutorial framing functions as a promotional funnel. After presenting indicators and trading instructions, the speaker directs viewers to Bybit, describes bank-account deposits, advertises access to more than 150 cryptocurrencies and up to 100-times leverage, and says the link provides a deposit bonus. The description adds several exchange links, referral codes, and registration bonuses. Thus the educational surface supplies credibility for steering beginners toward an account-opening and deposit pathway.

citations.quote: you can press the link below this video and take a look at Bybit. On this platform, you can easily make a deposit from your bank account and trade over 150 cryptocurrencies!
You can use leverage up to 100 times while trading to make profits even faster.
Through the link you will get a deposit bonus up to $453.
BYBIT REFERRAL CODE: 31310

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference opening treats the exchange promotion as incidental, but the speaker explicitly interrupts the strategy explanation to direct viewers to an exchange, explain bank deposits, advertise leverage, and connect the link to a bonus. For beginners, the instructional framing makes that solicitation more credible; it does not neutralize the commercial pathway.

citations.quote: By the way, if you are wondering which exchange I trade Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies on, you can press the link below this video and take a look at Bybit.
Through the link you will get a deposit bonus up to $453.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted promotion shows a disclosed exchange referral, not a hidden scam mechanism. The principal content remains a manual chart demonstration: it specifies indicators, trend conditions, entries, exits, and a backtest. The quotes do not show that viewers must use the link, that the exchange is fake, or that the advertised bonus cannot be obtained under its stated terms.
